method: Read symbol sequence using official Doodle Code JavaScript after local contrast extraction, then reconstruct a clean vector diagram from the decoded bit sequence.
validation: Official decoder JavaScript returned the same 38-bit sequence from the reconstructed PNG.
reading_direction: Top row left-to-right; follow the right-hand connector down; bottom row right-to-left.
intent_caveat: The result preserves the stably decoded sequence, which may differ from the user's intended message.
